bias.label: Leaning up above 4,100; 4,200 is the cap

event: US October CPI, Tue 10 Nov 15:30 SAST (headline forecast 0.3% m/m). US PPI Fri 13 Nov 15:30 SAST.

bullets.title: Monday push higher
bullets.text: Spot gold was about 4,122 at 07:16 SAST, up about 1.3% from Friday's 4,070, with a day range of 4,053-4,135 so far (Kitco).

bullets.title: Oil eases inflation fears
bullets.text: Brent is near 97.4 after its biggest weekly drop since 2020 on US-Iran talk progress, which eases inflation worries and helps gold (Reuters via MarketScreener, Mitrade).

bullets.title: Dollar slightly softer
bullets.text: The dollar index is near 102.1 and the US yield shown is near 4.88% (Trading Economics; exact time UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Hike odds very high
bullets.text: Trading Economics puts odds of a quarter-point Fed hike before year-end near 81%, up from 71% before Friday's payrolls.

bullets.title: CPI is the test
bullets.text: October CPI lands Tuesday 15:30 SAST; a soft print helps gold and a hot one helps sellers (Mitrade).

bullets.title: Still under big averages
bullets.text: The 50 and 100-day averages sit near 4,197-4,202, so the bigger trend has not turned up yet (Mitrade weekly).

levels.note: 50 and 100-day averages, top of the 3,870-4,200 range (Mitrade weekly)
Mitrade resistance 2, includes last week's high near 4,148

buy.title: Buy plan: dip that holds 4,100
look: A dip into 4,100-4,110 that closes back up on the 15M.
Use half size: price is still under the 50 and 100-day averages.
Take profit or tighten before CPI on Tuesday 15:30 SAST.
watch: Chasing above 4,130 instead of waiting for the pullback.
81% hike odds can pull gold back under 4,100 fast.
A hot CPI on Tuesday can wipe out Monday's gains.
Moving your stop lower when price gets close. That is how a small loss becomes a big one.

sell.title: Sell plan (counter-trend): rejection at 4,187-4,202
look: This is counter-trend to today's push, so wait for price to reach the zone first.
A 15M rejection wick or bearish close inside 4,187-4,202.
The dollar index turning back above 102.3.
A hot CPI on Tuesday 15:30 SAST would support the sell case; wait for it to print.
watch: Falling oil and Iran talks are helping gold, so sellers may be early.
Selling in the middle near 4,120-4,135 with no level to lean on.
A soft CPI can push gold through 4,200.
Re-entering again and again after being stopped out. One attempt, then step away.
